personal.name: Ramanuj Saket
personal.title: AI/ML/Gen-AI Engineer
personal.bio: Hi, I'm Ramanuj — an AI/ML Engineer with 4+ years of experience, including 3+ years focused on Generative AI, Agentic AI, and machine learning model development. I currently work at IIT Mandi iHub & HCI Foundation, building and deploying AI systems for healthcare, travel, and industrial clients, while pursuing an Executive M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence at IIT Jodhpur alongside full-time work. I build AI chatbots, computer vision systems, and automated agent workflows, and deploy models on AWS cloud infrastructure. I enjoy working directly with clients and cross-functional teams, and I'm known for clear technical documentation and mentoring junior team members.

Designed, developed, and maintained Java-based applications and web services using Core Java and the Spring framework. Delivered customized software features aligned with client requirements, strengthening foundational skills in scalable, production-quality software engineering.
Managed warehouse operations using SAP S/4HANA Cloud. Generated daily inventory reports for senior management decision-making.

projects.title: Child Malnutrition Classification
projects.client: Women Development and Child Welfare, Andhra Pradesh Government
projects.description: Developed AI agents to automate verification and validation of malnutrition data for 1,648 children, eliminating manual errors and reducing validation time by 95%. Built a custom AI-enabled hybrid image annotation tool using 22 landmark points and contour extraction, processing 8,193 child left-arm images and cutting project development time by approximately 80%. Developed an offline, Android-based AI screening tool for Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) detection using 2D Geometric Morphometrics, enabling scalable field screening in low-resource environments. Achieved an overall accuracy of 90.68% using Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) on an 18-landmark model (removing redundant landmarks to avoid collinearity) after allometric correction, with fOPA aligned to the mean target.

projects.title: HCIverse - Multimodal No-Code AI Workflow Platform
projects.description: Built a visual platform to design multimodal AI pipelines by connecting 30+ models across image, video, audio, and text. Developed with React Flow (frontend) and FastAPI (backend), featuring a custom DAG execution engine (Kahn's algorithm), real-time node streaming via WebSockets, secure authentication, and persistent project storage in MongoDB. Integrated Cloudflare Workers AI for asset caching and fallback routing.

projects.title: AI-Agentic Chatbot - LogisEye
projects.description: Built a multilingual AI chatbot with a custom UI to handle freight queries, shipment tracking, pricing insights, and more. Integrated voice, WhatsApp, and external APIs.

projects.title: Face Recognition for Furhat Social Robot
projects.description: Developed a real-time face recognition system for guest authentication at events, achieving 96.8% accuracy. Enhanced recognition performance by integrating XGBoost with LBPH (+22% accuracy improvement), later extending to deep learning frameworks (MTCNN, DeepFace, MediaPipe) for robust deployment on the Furhat Social Robot.
